title: Local Python web app with validated JSON API and UI
what: Stdlib Python web app: a form page posts input to /api/process, which validates it and returns a JSON summary or structured JSON errors.
shows: Input validation, 200/400/422 JSON responses, a page rendering the returned JSON, and saved responses for valid, empty and malformed input.
checks: valid input sum and mean match independent calculation
empty and malformed bodies return 400 JSON errors
invalid fields return 422 with per-field errors
done: Structured JSON errors with status codes
remaining: Real input fields and output shape
limits: Synthetic sample input only; stdlib server, not Flask; no browser screenshot was taken in this sandbox; no deployment.
